rebuttal_or_critique: The persistence of food inflation at 8.69 per cent is a clear signal that the battle against inflation is not yet won. With the economy operating at a positive output gap of 0.40 per cent and GVA growth at a robust 6.80 per cent, there is no macroeconomic justification for easing the policy stance. To shift to neutral or cut rates now would be to ignore the risk of second-round effects and the potential for inflation expectations to drift away from our 4.00 per cent target. I remain steadfast in my commitment to the withdrawal of accommodation until headline inflation durably aligns with the target.
